edges.notes: Vulkan uses SPIR-V as the shader intermediate representation for GPU execution (shader modules).
Vulkan drivers and loaders run on Linux hosts.
Vulkan on Windows via vendor ICDs and the Vulkan loader.
Both Khronos GPU-oriented APIs; different primary programming models (graphics-first vs compute-first).
Overlapping GPU graphics API space; OpenGL is the legacy state-machine API (coexistence is common).
Overlapping GPU API space; Metal is the primary path on Apple platforms (Vulkan may appear via layers like MoltenVK).
Overlapping GPU API space on Windows and in cross-platform engines (Vulkan vs Direct3D 12 is a common porting axis).
Browser engines and native WebGPU implementations often use Vulkan as the backend API on supported platforms.
Overlapping mobile/embedded GPU API space; many devices support or migrate between GLES and Vulkan.
